targets.query:
from(bucket: "Test_Capteurs")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mesures_capteurs")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nom_couche == "milieu isolant")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "nom_mur"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["nom_mur"])

from(bucket: "Test_Capteurs")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mesures_capteurs")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidite")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nom_couche == "milieu isolant")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "nom_mur"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["nom_mur"])
